workload.name: Rust: spotify-player
workload.description: Cold build of aome510/spotify-player, the project Namespace uses for its own Rust caching benchmark: checkout, apt dependencies, toolchain install, cargo fmt, cargo test, and two cargo clippy passes. No cache.
